what: The same plugin answering the radiative branch live.
outcome: one step completed, then a rank died from signal 9 and the job was killed: the four nodes' 256 GB were exceeded (268 GB used; the same run with nothing bound uses 225 GB)
diagnosis: Every rank compiles the emulator's table kernel with Numba at its first radiative step -- the LLVM compilation and the network's weights frozen into the code add about 0.35 GB a rank, 45 GB over 128 ranks a node -- and the job asked 64 GB a node.  Not a fault of the slot: the whole-image gates on the same build (7418221, 7418222) are bit-for-bit.
disposition: Resubmitted with 235 GB a node (rad-slot-shadow2, rad-slot-live2); the job's comparison and health files of the killed run are kept with this record and the tag is not reused.
bfb_record_note: pi_cam_pausable_rad-slot-live_vs_oracle_50step_bfb.json and the .health.json were written by the job's comparison of the killed run; kept with this record.
